contracts_rationale: The pack contract is owned by spec-kitty-charter contracts/packs; this mission authors pack content and defines no interface.
purpose_context: Teams building in Rust or Go get no stack doctrine from Spec Kitty today. This mission adds two opt-in org packs, rust and go, each with a conventions styleguide, a review-checks toolguide and a specialist profile, authored for this repository under MIT, so a project can activate idiomatic guidance for its stack with one preset.
purpose_tldr: Ship opt-in Rust and Go Charter Packs with real, general-purpose language conventions and review checks.
